resources.string: community — open the experimental opt-in Re-TUI community feed. Inside: plain text posts; /help lists local commands. Username/password only. No launcher commands run in this surface.
Input rejected; use /help. Slash commands take no password arguments. Messages: 500 Unicode characters / 2000 UTF-8 bytes maximum.

One room: Re-TUI community. Plain text posts on Send. exit posts; /exit leaves. //text posts /text. Unknown slash commands stay here.
/help · /refresh · /older · /login · /register · /logout · /exit
/report <full message ID> · /block <username> (local only; repeat to unblock)
Username/password only. Public registration, authenticated reading/posting. No forgotten-password recovery: register a new username; it is a separate identity, not a reclaim or history/ownership transfer.
Server-readable; no end-to-end encryption. General messages expire after 24 hours; private report evidence is retained for six calendar months. Local cache: at most 200 messages, pruned on opening and while visible, including offline. Paused encrypted cache bytes may remain until reopening; no secure-erasure guarantee. Cached messages are rechecked for moderation when connected.
PocketBase is pre-1.0; this optional pilot may change. No push, background service, attachments, private messages, automatic links or launcher execution.

Username: 3–24 ASCII letters, digits, - or _. Password: at least 8 characters. No forgotten-password recovery: use a new username, a separate identity. Old usernames cannot be reclaimed; no automatic ownership or history migration.
Sign in or register first. Draft kept; nothing was sent.
Network/TLS request failed. Cached history may be stale; draft kept. Nothing will post automatically.
Session expired, revoked or account unavailable. Signed out; private cache and draft cleared.
Registration rejected. Check username uniqueness, password length and matching confirmation. If creation succeeded but login failed, try Login; account creation alone is not sign-in.
Rate limited; wait %1$d seconds before retrying.
Request failed (%1$d). No success was confirmed.
Delivery uncertain. Pending draft kept with the same request ID. Send the same draft again to reconcile/retry; do not send a second copy. No automatic retry.
Previous attempt is unresolved. Restore its draft with /refresh and submit it unchanged to reconcile/retry, or /logout to clear local state (this does not retract any server post).
Signed out. Account cache, blocks, draft and token cleared.
Keep the draft privately for next time, or discard it. Nothing is uploaded. Discarding an uncertain draft does not retract a possible server post.
No cached messages. Sign in and /refresh to fetch the room.
Private encrypted storage is unavailable. No post was started; draft is only in this window.
A request is in progress; wait before submitting again.
